collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: The village leader has always planned the harvest festival but notices that a young cook has far better ideas this year.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), the village leader, has always planned the harvest festival but notices that a young cook has far better ideas this year.

choices.label: Ask the Village Whom They Would Like.
Keep the Planning but Credit the Cook's Ideas.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The young cook feels overwhelmed, and the leader stays on as a quiet helper.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The old traditions and new ideas mix into something everyone enjoys.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The two disagree often, but the festival happens on time anyway.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Most villagers choose the young cook, and the leader takes the result in good spirit.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The village is split, so both planners share the work.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The cook is pleased to be named and offers more ideas next year.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The cook would have preferred to lead, and says so plainly; the leader promises to consider it next time.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: The young cook organizes a festival that people talk about for months.
